project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA with Konva canvas, Zustand state management, Supabase backend
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, setup in src/test-setup.ts
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc -b && npx vite build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run. 3. Run build: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc -b && npx vite build
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npm install (already done, node_modules exists)
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running any node/npm commands due to proxy-bootstrap module issue. No Docker needed. Supabase client configured but env vars not set (tests mock supabase).
contribution_requirements: All tests must pass. TypeScript strict mode. Use existing patterns for stores, components, and tests.
key_patterns: Zustand stores in src/stores/ with State+Actions pattern exported as types. Components use data-testid attributes for testing. Supabase calls via fromTable() helper from @/lib/supabase. Tests mock @/lib/supabase with vi.mock. Path alias @/ maps to src/. CanvasMode.DESIGNER used for designer-only features. BomPanel pattern (side panel overlay) is a good model for the publish workflow panel.
directory_structure: frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores; frontend/src/components/ - UI components (some with __tests__/ subdirs); frontend/src/canvas/ - Konva canvas code with utils/; frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces and enums; frontend/src/lib/ - utilities like supabase client; frontend/src/hooks/ - empty hooks directory
